"Explain quantum computing to a 5-year-old:"
Imagine you have a magical coin that can be heads AND tails at the same time until you look at it. Quantum computers use this magic to solve really hard puzzles super fast!
// Write a function to find prime numbers
function findPrimes(n) {
  // ...
}
function findPrimes(n) {
  const primes = [];
  for (let i = 2; i <= n; i++) {
    let isPrime = true;
    for (let j = 2; j <= Math.sqrt(i); j++) {
      if (i % j === 0) isPrime = false;
    }
    if (isPrime) primes.push(i);
  }
  return primes;
}
